mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.25% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where housing starts increased by more than 5% over the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to increased corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals increased economic activity, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% over the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months signals a stable economic environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL has been below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month AND UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the last month signals a strong labor market, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 200,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% over the last two months and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a contractionary environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decrease > 1% in 2 months AND FEDFUNDS > 3%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.
